S64.02.needs: a signed-in account or local mode; an iPhone with Safari; the iOS app build with the share extension
S64.02.note: The share extension is iOS only, and the preview screen's send and 'Send to Chat' flow was read from code but the tester should check whether a question can be typed before sending, which the code read did not confirm.
steps: In Safari, select some text on a web page.
Tap the Share button and choose the AGI share extension, titled Share with AGI.
Open AGI Mobile. The share preview screen shows the selected text.
Look in the chat that opens: the assistant's reply should use the selected text as context.
S64.02.where: Safari > Share button > Share with AGI > Save for AGI Review > open AGI Mobile > Send to Chat

S64.05.needs: a signed-in account or local mode; an iPhone with Safari; the iOS app build with the share extension
S64.05.note: The button only appears when the shared text contains an http or https link, and it is disabled when files are attached. The code sends the link text and prompt; whether the assistant opens the page itself is not shown in the code.
steps: In Safari, open a web page, tap the Share button and choose Share with AGI.
Tap Save for AGI Review, then open AGI Mobile.
On the share preview screen, find the two buttons under the shared text.
Look in the new chat: a reply starting from the prompt 'Summarize this page.' should appear, with the page link in the message.
S64.05.where: Safari > Share button > Share with AGI > Save for AGI Review > open AGI Mobile > Summarize this page

S64.06.needs: a signed-in account or local mode (the button is disabled otherwise); an iPhone with Safari; the iOS app build with the share extension
S64.06.note: The page content that reaches the answer is the shared text (usually only the URL plus any selected text), not a full read of the page; the code does not show the assistant opening the page.
steps: In Safari, open a web page, tap the Share button and choose Share with AGI.
Tap Save for AGI Review, then open AGI Mobile.
On the share preview screen, tap Ask about this page.
The chat opens with the shared text placed in the message box. Type your own question after it.
Send the question and look at the reply: it should answer using the page's content that was shared.
S64.06.where: Safari > Share button > Share with AGI > Save for AGI Review > open AGI Mobile > Ask about this page
